name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 6 visits over 28 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 28 hours starting 2025-05-09, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.72 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
